biome.guhs.vadsrijk_hoogvads_academie: The Chonkdom - Highchonk - the Cloudwatch Academy
biome.guhs.vadsrijk_hoogvads_kathedraal: The Chonkdom - Highchonk - the Order Cathedral
biome.guhs.vadsrijk_hoogvads_ooggaarde: The Chonkdom - Highchonk - the Eye Garden
biome.guhs.vadsrijk_pierkop: The Chonkdom - Pierhead and the Liftoff Pier

erfenis.gebouw.konijnenren.uitleg: Guh bunnies with soft bunny fluff. And manure. Lots and lots of manure. Great for the flowers!
erfenis.gebouw.weverij.uitleg: Wool becomes cloth scraps, bunny fluff becomes plushie fabric, cloud fluff and giant wool become wool again.
guhs.configuration.bazenmuziek.tooltip: Every boss has its own theme during the fight (percent, 0 = off).
guhs.configuration.gebiedsmuziek.tooltip: Soft music outside the towns, with long silences in between (percent, 0 = off). Also follows Minecraft's Music slider.
guhs.configuration.geroezemoes.tooltip: A soft guh crowd murmur in busy places (Highchonk, the bazaar of Saffron Gate, the market of Sugarbowl, ...), with now and then a 'nyeg', a giggle, a squeak or a blub. Quieter at night (percent, 0 = off). Also follows the Ambient slider.
guhs.configuration.omgeving.tooltip: Birds, water, chimes, crickets at night, drips in caves, bees, waves (percent, 0 = off). Also follows the Ambient slider.
guhs.configuration.pauze_max: Chonkdom: silence between pieces, at most (s)
guhs.configuration.pauze_max.tooltip: Seconds of only ambience after an area piece.
guhs.configuration.pauze_min: Chonkdom: silence between pieces, at least (s)
guhs.configuration.pauze_min.tooltip: Seconds of only ambience after an area piece.
guhs.configuration.stadsmuziek.tooltip: Sweet little tunes in Shroomsbury, Camp Snuggle, The Harbor, Sugarbowl and Honeybough (Music slider). OFF = the normal music there again.
guhs.configuration.stemmen.tooltip: The little guh voices of NPCs: a 'guh!' when you talk to them, a little question, a thank-you (percent, 0 = off). Also follows the Friendly Creatures slider.
guhs.configuration.stingers.tooltip: Short musical ta-daas: a new area, a quest done, a level up, a boss beaten, a secret found (percent, 0 = off).
guhs.configuration.vadsrijkSchud.tooltip: How hard the screen shakes and the camera moves along with heavy hits and boss moments. 0 = off.
guhs.configuration.vadsrijkStemmen: Chonkdom: little voices in the talk screen (%)
guhs.configuration.vadsrijkStemmen.toolt: How loud the soft blip per word is (guh, Mika, narrator). 0 = off.
guhs.configuration.vadsrijkTekstSnelheid: Chonkdom: talk text speed (0 = instant, 3 = fast)
How fast the text in the talk screen appears. A click always shows all of it at once.
guhs.configuration.vadsrijkVfx.tooltip: Boss particles, shockwaves, beams and flashes. Ground telegraphs always stay visible.
guhs.configuration.wereldgeluiden.toolti: Soft little sounds of places close by: fountains, beehives, the smithy hammer, wind chimes, campfires, creaking lifts, an echo of your steps in caves (percent, 0 = off). Also follows the Ambient slider. (Crowd murmur has its own slider.)
gui.guhs.titels.hint.uritme_grote_knuffe: Make 120 guhs happy across the towns of the Chonkdom.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.uritme_knuffelvrien: Make 25 guhs happy in one town of the Chonkdom (wave, cuddle, dance!).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_de_la: Fully explore The Lantern Coast (Exploration Book, key B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_de_sc: Fully explore The Duskroot (Exploration Book, key B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_de_sp: Do everything in The Splinter Peaks of the Chonkdom (Exploration Book, B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_het_z: Fully explore The Silklands (Exploration Book, key B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_hoogv: Fully explore Highchonk (Exploration Book, key B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_kenner_van_zwamz: Do everything in The Snuggle Shrooms of the Chonkdom (Exploration Book, B).
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_marktkoopman: Sell ten things at the market of Shroomsbury.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_ridder_van_het_z: Play 'The Star Caravan' to the end.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_ridder_van_zwamz: For sale at Home Delivery in the Chonkdom.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_rijdiermeester: Ride a mount to the highest level.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_sjacheraar: Haggle nicely with three merchants in the Grand Bazaar of Saffron Gate.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_sterrensmid: Tap ten stars onto one piece of gear.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_vadsmuntenbaron: Very pricey, at Home Delivery in the Chonkdom.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vr_vriend_van_ringe: Cheer up Duchess Ringaling, at the top of The Star-Snuffing Tower.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.z6raid_sterrenaanst: Clear The Star-Snuffing Tower without fainting even once.
gui.guhs.vadsrijk.roep.niet_hier: Your guhs stay cozy at home while you're off adventuring in the Chonkdom, nyeg.
item.guhs.vr_amb_ambachtskist.uitleg: The weekly chest from the Order Board. Right-click to open.
item.guhs.vr_amb_amberkoper.uitleg: Warm copper from the root tunnels of The Duskroot (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_bijenwas.uitleg: For candles, decor and the sewing studio.
item.guhs.vr_amb_dadelpalmhout.uitleg: Wood from the palms by the oases (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_donderforel.uitleg: Comes up when it rains. Rumbles in your fishing rod (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_drijfhout.uitleg: Wood that the pink sea has petted smooth (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_duinhoning.uitleg: Light honey from the dune flowers by the Beach Party (zone 4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_glinstergruis.uitleg: Rare: from a glittering vein. For Masterwork and radiant crystals.
item.guhs.vr_amb_gouden_klaver.uitleg: Rare: a little clover made of gold. Brings luck (or so they say).
item.guhs.vr_amb_hemelhoning.uitleg: Golden honey from the Eye Garden of Highchonk (zone 5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_hemelzilver.uitleg: Silver from the fins of Mother Cloudwhale. Light as a little cloud (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_honingkarper.uitleg: Comes up when it rains. Tastes like honey (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_ijsbloem.uitleg: A flower that never melts, from the Echo Slopes (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kandijzilver.uitleg: Silver with a sugary shine from the Splinter Gorge (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kern_lampionkern.uitleg: A boss core from zone 4. Needed for Masterwork Jewelry (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kern_splinterkern.uitle: A boss core from zone 2. Needed for Masterwork Jewelry (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kern_sterrenkern.uitleg: A boss core from zone 6. Needed for Masterwork Jewelry (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kern_wolkkern.uitleg: A boss core from zone 5. Needed for Masterwork Jewelry (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kern_wortelkern.uitleg: A boss core from zone 3. Needed for Masterwork Jewelry (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kern_zwamkern.uitleg: A boss core from zone 1. Needed for Masterwork Jewelry (T1).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kernsplinter.uitleg: Five splinters make a boss core at the smithy.
item.guhs.vr_amb_klodderklaver.uitleg: Four leaves and a little bit sticky. For the kitchen and the brewery (T1).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kloddervisje.uitleg: A blue fishy with a blobby little tummy (T1).
item.guhs.vr_amb_koninginnengelei.uitleg: Rare: the yummiest thing in the hive. For the Honey Elixir.
item.guhs.vr_amb_koraalbaars.uitleg: A pink perch that lives among the coral (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kristalden.uitleg: Pine wood with ice crystals from the Crystal Woods (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_kristalvlas.uitleg: Glittering flax from the slopes. For the sewing studio (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_lampionbrons.uitleg: Warm bronze from the cliffs of The Lantern Coast. Glows a little, just like a lantern (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_lampionhoning.uitleg: Orange honey from the Bee Farm on Flower Island (zone 4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_lantaarnvis.uitleg: Only bites at night. Has her own little lamp (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_lichtkeverkruid.uitleg: An herb that gives off a soft glow (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_maanrog.uitleg: Only bites at night. Swims like a little kite (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_oerbast.uitleg: Rare: bark from a very old tree. Smells like the olden days.
item.guhs.vr_amb_parelschelp.uitleg: Rare: a shell with a pink pearl.
item.guhs.vr_amb_pluisijzer.uitleg: Soft pink iron from the Drip Caves. For the smithy (T1).
item.guhs.vr_amb_pluiskatoen.uitleg: Soft fluffs from the Blob Meadow. For the sewing studio (T1).
item.guhs.vr_amb_regenboogmakreel.uitleg: Comes up when it rains. Shimmers in every color (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_roze_koraal.uitleg: Pried loose while diving in Coral Bay. Grows back (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_rozenzandsteen.uitleg: Pink stone from the Rose Gorge (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_saffraan.uitleg: The orange gold of the saffron fields (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_saffraanhoning.uitleg: Orange honey from the date gardens (zone 6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_schemerhout.uitleg: Dark, softly shining wood from the Root Fields (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_schemerzijde.uitleg: Purple silk from The Duskroot. For the sewing studio (T3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_sneeuwsnoek.uitleg: Comes up when it rains or snows (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_spiegelforel.uitleg: You can see yourself in her scales (T2).
item.guhs.vr_amb_sterrengoud.uitleg: Gold from the star dunes of the Silklands (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_sterrenschubvis.uitleg: Only bites at night, under the stars (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_sterrenspiering.uitleg: Only bites at night. Twinkles like a little star (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_vlieger.uitleg: Made of kite bamboo and sea yarn. For your home: hang it up and it smiles at you.
item.guhs.vr_amb_vliegerbamboe.uitleg: Bendy bamboo from Kite Island. Perfect for kites (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_wolkbes.uitleg: A blue berry that tastes like rain, from the gardens of Highchonk (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_wolkenhoning.uitleg: Almost white honey from Tail Park of Highchonk (zone 5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_wolkenhout.uitleg: Almost weightless wood from Tail Park of Highchonk (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_wolkenvis.uitleg: A see-through fishy from the ponds of Highchonk (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_wolkenwol.uitleg: Tufts of cloud, as soft as a cuddle. For the sewing studio (T5).
item.guhs.vr_amb_wortelhoning.uitleg: Dark honey from the Glowbeetle Woods (zone 3).
item.guhs.vr_amb_zeegaren.uitleg: Yarn spun from seagrass. For the sewing studio (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_zeekraal.uitleg: A salty, crunchy little beach plant. Yummy with fish (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_zeesponsje.uitleg: A soft yellow sponge from the seabed. A diving find (T4).
item.guhs.vr_amb_zijdedraad.uitleg: The softest thread of the Silk Road (T6).
item.guhs.vr_amb_zwamsteel.uitleg: A piece of stem from a giant shroom in the Sporewood (T1).
item.guhs.vr_item_energiedrankje.uitleg: Gives you back 50 energy. A little fizzy, nyeg!
item.guhs.vr_item_herrolknabbel.uitleg: Rare! The smithguh uses it to reroll the bonuses on your gear.
item.guhs.vr_item_klein_vadsdrankje.uitl: Gives you back 120 Chonk. A sip of strawberry for the road.
item.guhs.vr_item_pluisdraad.uitleg: For sewing frayed gear back together at the smith.
item.guhs.vr_item_rijfluitje.uitleg: Whistles your mount over (once more: it hops home). No longer needed: the mount key does the same.
item.guhs.vr_item_vadsdrankje.uitleg: Gives you back 300 Chonk. Tastes like strawberries and cuddles.
item.guhs.vr_item_vahoegdrankje.uitleg: One minute of Wahoog: you feel super wahoog.
item.guhs.vr_item_verbetersteentje.uitle: The smithguh uses it to tap a little star onto your gear.
item.guhs.vr_mom_regenboogdrankje.uitleg: Gives you 700 Chonk and 120 energy, plus 90 s of Wahoog, Quickpaws and a Snuggle Shield.
item.guhs.vr_npc_mika_speldje.lore: On the back, engraved very small: a little hand with one raised pinkie.
item.guhs.vr_t_groeipluis.uitleg: From every boss. At the smith it lets a Legendary or Guhvine piece grow further.
item.guhs.vr_t_knuffeltalisman.uitleg: At the smith: switch it on and a failed star won't cost you a star. Only then is it used up.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_galmkristal.flav: Sings softly back when you tap it. You strike faster.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_ijsglans.flavour: Always cold, even in hot cocoa. Sometimes freezes what you hit.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_rozekwarts.flavo: Warm pink and a little sticky. Gives you more Chonk.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_spiegelkwarts.fl: You see yourself in it, only braver. More Defense.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_vonkkristal.flav: Crackles in your pocket. Your elements get stronger.
item.guhs.vr_z2_kristal_zonnesteen.flavo: Catches the last bit of sunshine of the day. Your hits find the weak spot more often.
item.guhs.vr_z2_npc_drakensplinter.lore: Gray, hard and a little curved. Just like a nail clipping. From something veeery big. Ew.
item.guhs.vr_z2_warme_chocomelk.op: Mmm, hot cocoa. Your toes are thawing out.
item.guhs.vr_z2_warme_chocomelk.uitleg: Gives you 250 Chonk, thaws you out (Frozen is gone) and keeps you warm for 3 minutes (you can't freeze).
item.guhs.vr_z3_bloesemthee.op: A sip of spring. You feel all clean again.
item.guhs.vr_z3_bloesemthee.uitleg: Gives you 400 Chonk and 60 energy, and washes away Sticky and Spored.
item.guhs.vr_z3_gouden_veer.uitleg: Right-click: onto your Golden Feathers counter (sneaking: the whole stack). 25 feathers = the Golden Plumeguh from Stable Master Feathers.
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_amberroze.flavou: Pink resin from the trunk. Sticky and warm. Every hit gives you back a little Chonk.
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_honingkristal.fl: Smells like the comb clusters of Honeybough. Your heals get sweeter (stronger).
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_schemerkristal.f: Catches the light of dusk. Your skills are ready again sooner.
item.guhs.vr_z3_kristal_wortelkristal.fl: Grown among the old roots. Sturdy as the tree itself: more Defense.
item.guhs.vr_z3_npc_boomvolkkaart: Tree Folk Map of the Tribe
item.guhs.vr_z3_premiekist.uitleg: Your weekly goal from the Bounty Board! Right-click: an Epic or Legendary weapon, a crystal and a Golden Feather.
item.guhs.vr_z3_reuzen_energiedrank.op: Bzzzzzzt! Your little ears are crackling!
item.guhs.vr_z3_vahoegzegel.uitleg: Place it on the Wahoog Altar by a dungeon door: the bosses turn Wahoog (lv 50, stronger, better loot and Golden Feathers).
item.guhs.vr_z4_kristal_parelkristal.fla: Round, soft and shiny. It makes you a bit sturdier: more Chonk.
item.guhs.vr_z4_kristal_zeeglas.flavour: A little shard of sea, polished round by the waves. More Element Resistance.
item.guhs.vr_z4_npc_soepkom: Bowl of Soup for a Refugee
item.guhs.vr_z4_npc_vissoep: Fish Soup from The Happy Halibut
item.guhs.vr_z5_npc_bevelbrief: Command Note with a Paw Stamp
item.guhs.vr_z5_npc_kaasje: Piece of Ripe Cheese (for a cheese test)
item.guhs.vr_z6_kristal_rozenkwarts.flav: Pink and warm. Your hits crit more often.
item.guhs.vr_z6_kristal_sterrenzout.flav: Hardened starlight from the Salt Flats. More damage against bosses.
item.guhs.vr_z6_npc_sterrenlens: The Star Lens (right-click: how many beacons are lit)
item.guhs.vr_z6_npc_tablet: Stone Tablet of the Star Guhs
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.angora_pluisj: Super-soft fluff on the cellar step. Bunny fluff! Doesn't that come from...
